# Charlie Sloane

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is a boy characterized by his distinctive goggle eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbors clear ambitions for his future, openly expressing a desire to enter the political sphere. His primary goal is to eventually serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

- go into politics and be a member of Parliament  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Charlie Sloane was a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who admired her intellect, telling his mother that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was the smartest girl in school. He once engaged in a physical fight with [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md) after Moody claimed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) put on airs about her recitations. Charlie also shared a story that his grandmother had seen his deceased grandfather driving cows home a year after his burial.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
